title: Descent: Legends of the Dark
subtitle: App-driven cooperative dungeon crawler with striking 3D terrain in the realm of Terrinoth
tagline: Forge your legend across a realm shrouded in rising darkness
loreSummary: You are fledgling heroes answering the call in the troubled barony of Terrinoth. Guided by companion app narration and fighting across multi-level 3D battlegrounds, your choices and crafting will decide the fate of a kingdom.
keyFeatures: Integrated companion app orchestrating enemy AI, traps, and dynamic story branching
Multi-tiered 3D cardboard terrain creating vertical, multi-elevation tactical combat
Double-sided character and weapon cards with in-depth crafting and equipment upgrades
Rich campaign with immersive narrative choices shaping hero development
